welcomeBanner.title: Welcome to Monthly Schedule Manager
welcomeBanner.description: Restore a backup file (.json) to instantly recover your entire team, availability, calendars and events. Or if you prefer, start a fresh manual setup from scratch.

cloudPull.title: Pull Cloud Data (Firestore)
cloudPull.description: Instantly recover the active month schedule and staff saved in Firestore to this device.
cloudPull.error: Failed to sync data with cloud.

dropzone.title: Select backup file
dropzone.description: Drag your JSON file or click below to select from your computer.
dropzone.supportHint: Supports .json files generated by Schedule Manager
dropzone.unexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred while processing the backup file.
dropzone.restoreError: Failed to restore backup data. Please try again.

preview.title: Valid Backup Preview
preview.existingDataNotice: You already have locally saved data. Choose whether to erase everything and use only the uploaded file, or update your current data while keeping non-conflicting records.

overwriteModal.title: Warning: Data Overwrite
overwriteModal.description: Warning: The application already contains saved data. This import will OVERWRITE all current staff, schedules and events irreversibly. Do you wish to continue?
